sections.markdown:
## E2 — Competitive teardown: curves, lane changes, passing, freeways and towing
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (OR-PASS-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: competitors may skip Oregon-specific rules such as ramp meters, the single towed unit limit and the ban on signaling others to pass; covering them could be a beat point once verified.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: Competitive teardown of Oregon knowledge-test prep products for the curves, lane changes, passing, freeways and towing topic is unresearched.
